mapper.select: select event_id, actor_id, solution_id, occurred_at, cursor_user_id, status, lease_owner, lease_until, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at from notification_fanout_job where event_id = #{eventId} for update

select event_id, actor_id, solution_id, occurred_at, cursor_user_id, status, lease_owner, lease_until, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at from notification_fanout_job where attempts < 20 and next_attempt_at <= #{now} and (status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'SENDING' and lease_until <= #{now})) order by next_attempt_at asc, created_at asc, event_id asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update notification_fanout_job set status = 'FAILED', lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, next_attempt_at = #{now}, last_error = 'LEASE_EXPIRED_AFTER_MAX_ATTEMPTS', updated_at = #{now} where status = 'SENDING' and lease_until <= #{now} and attempts >= 20 order by lease_until asc, event_id asc limit 1

update notification_fanout_job set status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = #{now}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, last_error = null, updated_at = #{now} where event_id = #{eventId} and status = 'FAILED'
